text: Seven forty-two. Rain on Line Four.
Then the sun came out, and someone forgot their umbrella.
It rode the line all day. Nobody needs an umbrella in the sun.
At the end of the line, it joined three hundred and twelve others.
Then, at rush hour, the storm came back.
Three hundred and thirteen umbrellas went back out into the rain.
Lost on a sunny day. Found on a rainy one.
